questions.ask: What pops up when Tim tips the box?
questions.listenFor: His cat, Tom. It is stated in the story, so if they guess, have them go back and find the line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Where does Tim nap at the end?
questions.listenFor: On the rug. Follow up with "and why not the box?" to see if they linked the two parts of the story.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim is mad at Tom? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You want a reason tied to the story - "yes, he wanted the box" or "no, Tom is his pet."
